name: Class-A Preferred Stock of ITO EN,LTD.
summary: Class-A Preferred Stock of ITO EN,LTD. is a beverage company headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, formed in 1964, that produces and distributes green tea drinks worldwide. Its range also covers Japanese, black, flavored and Chinese teas, coffee, drinks made from fruit, vegetables or dairy, and loose tea leaves. Brands include Oi Ocha and TULLY's COFFEE. It was founded as Frontier Tea Corporation and renamed in 1969.
